# New-ZbxMfa

## SYNOPSIS

Creates an MFA method.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxMfa [[-Name] <string>] [[-Type] <ZabbixMfaType>] [-HashFunction <ZabbixMfaHashFunction>] [-CodeLength <ZabbixMfaCodeLength>] [-ApiHostName <string>] [-ClientId <string>] [-ClientSecret <SecureString>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A multi-factor authentication method asks users for a second factor at login: a time-based one-time password or Duo Universal Prompt. The New-ZbxMfa cmdlet sends mfa.create with one request field per parameter, then reads the new MFA method back with mfa.get and writes it. The server requires -Type and -Name; -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name and wins over a parameter. -WhatIf shows what would be created, and the command needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Create an MFA method

```powershell
New-ZbxMfa -Name 'Authenticator app' -Type Totp -HashFunction Sha256 -CodeLength Six
```

Creates an MFA method named Authenticator app. The command writes the new MFA method, read back from the server.

- `string`: Bound to -Name (ByPropertyName), -ApiHostName (ByPropertyName), -ClientId (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixMfaHashFunction`: Bound to -HashFunction (ByPropertyName). The MFA hash function values: TOTP_HASH_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixMfaCodeLength`: Bound to -CodeLength (ByPropertyName). The MFA code length values: TOTP_CODE_LENGTH_* in defines.inc.php.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.
